summary.text: Jen Bloomquist is the Democratic candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 31B, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Peggy Scott (R).
A union member and working mother, she says her campaign centers on affordability, transparency and accountability.

paragraphs.text: Jen Bloomquist earned a high school diploma from Bakersfield High School and an associate degree from Eastern Gateway Community College in 2023, and her listed career experience is as a public servant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Bloomquist described herself as a working mom and union member and said she is passionate about health care, human services and workers' rights.
